editorial:
Imagine marrying your dream guy, only to realize he is changing into someone you don't recognize. You get to follow Kelly, who thinks she has hit the jackpot with Nick. At first, he seems perfect, but then things get weird. He suddenly stops hanging out with his drinking buddies and becomes obsessed with starting a family. It feels like a typical marriage drama at first, but it quickly turns into a creepy sci-fi mystery. You will feel Kelly's confusion as she tries to figure out why her husband is acting so strange and what he is actually hiding behind that smile.

The acting is surprisingly solid for a TV movie, and the slow build-up of tension keeps you guessing. While some of the special effects look a bit dated now, the story makes up for it with a fun twist. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV for a crisp picture. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a smart move to keep this hidden gem forever.
endingExplained: You find out that Nick is actually an alien who has taken over a human body. He wants to have babies to create a hybrid race and take over. In the final scenes, Kelly discovers the truth and has to fight for her life. She eventually manages to stop him before he can complete his plan. The movie wraps up with Kelly escaping the nightmare, leaving the alien threat behind for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school creature features and suspenseful marriage stories.
